q: Sturm-Liouville theory concerns the eigenvalue problem (p(x)y')' + (λw(x) - q(x))y = 0. Its eigenfunctions form:
opts: A complete orthogonal basis in L²([a,b], w dx)
An orthonormal basis with w = 1 only
A basis only when p > 0 everywhere
exp: The Sturm-Liouville operator is self-adjoint in L²([a,b], w dx) with the weight function w. Its eigenfunctions are complete and orthogonal with respect to the weighted inner product.
